findings: Finite maximum neighborhood packing is nonvacuous through the empty candidate; maximality gives a real edge from every eligible uncovered vertex into an existing core. Owner fibers preserve each whole core, are disjoint, and cover all eligible vertices.
Radius-two attachment constructs support-contained walks of length at most four, not just ambient reachability. The actual old-branch union consequently has intrinsic weighted diameter at most 4M+5D.

The marked original host-edge map is proved injective using unordered endpoint-label equality and the genuine heavy-edge uniqueness contract. Internal heavy loops are excluded separately; no parallel host edges are dropped silently.

The final geometric premise derives both quotient girth and the heavy uniqueness budget. Genuine minor exclusion transfers through the actual quotient model and induced-subgraph embedding before the exact high-girth density theorem is applied.

Disjoint groups give an exact pooled-credit sum. Half remains in each actual new group, the other half pays all marked original edges using their upper weight bound. This uses aggregate density only, with no invalid pointwise degree inference.
explicit_scope: Finite simple host, supplied old intrinsic low-diameter ClusterFamily and actual light/heavy subgraphs.
Positive lower scale, nonnegative diameter and upper edge scale, actual weighted girth and explicit geometric inequality.
